newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Tissue says FDA panel date set.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Tissue says FDA panel date set.

text.p: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has placed Advanced Tissue Sciences Inc's Dermagraft-TC on the November 19 agenda of an agency advisory panel, the company said on Tuesday.
The device will go before the General and Plastic Surgery Devices Panel of the Medical Devices Advisory Committee, Advanced Tissue said. It is being reviewed under the FDA's expedited review process.
Dermagraft-TC is a bioengineered human dermal tissue combined with a synthetic epidermal layer designed as an alternative to cadaver skin for severely burned patients.
